item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meera keeps a steel tiffin box on her study table. She notices that the tiffin box always keeps the same shape and the same size, no matter where she places it.

Why does a solid like the steel tiffin box have a definite shape and a definite volume?

options.A: Its particles are tightly packed and attract each other very strongly, so they stay in fixed positions and only vibrate.
options.B: Its particles are tightly packed, and this tight packing alone holds the shape even though the particles attract each other only weakly.
options.C: Its particles move freely throughout the box but the hard outer surface stops the box from changing shape.
options.D: The fixed shape and volume of the box push its particles close together and make their attractions strong.
